jsonld_raw.name: (350 G) MIMOSA SUBLIME SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Mimosa Sublime | A floral scent that transports you to a field full of beautiful mimosa flowers. Delicate floral traces surrounded by an aromatic burst of cardamom and eucalyptus blend with the colorful essence of mimosa, which shines at the heart of the fragrance, revealing its voluptuousness through powdery and balsamic accords.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, cardamom, eucalyptus.
Heart notes: violet, mimosa.
Base notes: musk, solar notes.
